title: 🕵️ Детектор лжи: Present Simple
description: В предложениях спрятаны ошибки в Present Simple. Кликни на неверное слово. Если ошибки нет — нажми «Всё верно!».

items.text: Am I a good singer? Yes, I am.
We isn't ready for the lesson.
The books is on the shelf.
It aren't a spider, it is a fly.
Is your brother a student? Yes, he are.
The ruler are in the bag.
I am play tennis every day.
